name: emu-composer
description: Write prompts for coding agents next to a live Android emulator: point at any UI element and get a reference resolved to the source that renders it. Drive the emulator from the same page. Dictate.

scripts.check: node --check bin/emu-composer.js && for f in src/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done && node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('src/ui/index.html','utf8');new Function(s.match(/<script>([\s\S]*)<\/script>/)[1])"

author: yairix studio
